sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived macro-cell-to-source binding map together with each source template and target palette color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Parse the keyed template bank, sparse macro-token bank, and bottom palette, then resolve every occupied macro cell to its source key under the declared binding mode.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Expand every occupied macro cell into its resolved source template and paint that template with the resolved source target color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Panel position is deliberately decorrelated from token identity. Replacing each token self-binding with the next occupied token changes which template and palette entry are rendered while leaving the board and output canvas fixed.

parametric_work.summary: Authored a general keyed-template decoder, constructive self/next-token binding family, decoder inspection tool, adversarial audit, and portability regressions. Supports 2–6 demonstrations, exactly four private queries, matched inputs across both settings, and source-bound protected-Racket evidence.
